title: QL-W-01A Signing refuses a contract with a test_red_green criterion when no base revision can be recorded (memev)
request: Programme contract QL-W-01A in memev: a contract with a test_red_green criterion is not signed without a base revision (work package WP23-01). It builds on the base revision that SR-0.03.3 T1 (signed) already records, and adds the refusal at signing. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. The id is in the style of SO-W-08B: its second part starts with a letter, so the redteam gate's specIdOf reads the whole name and the contract has its own record path; the work package number 23 is not in docs/scope-one/programme/fragments. Why: Vault.contractVerify returns BLOCKED with 'no base revision recorded' for every scope and test_red_green criterion of a contract whose body has no base (src/engine/contracts.mjs, baseCheck), because the red run is made in a worktree of the base. Vault.contractSign records a base only from an explicit base in the draft or from the HEAD of a workdir that is a git checkout (SR-0.03.3 T1 requirement 1), and signs without one otherwise. None of the 138 signed bodies in contracts/signed records a base, so no signed red-green criterion can reach PASS through verify; and 529 criteria in 17 contracts also lack base_commit in their red-team records. A contract that can never verify should not be signable. What changes: (1) for a local caller, contractSign refuses a contract that has at least one test_red_green criterion when, after the existing rule (the explicit base, else the workdir's HEAD), no base was found: it throws a ContractError with code no_base whose message says how to give one (a base in the draft, --base, or a workdir that is a git checkout), before the signature is made, and writes nothing (no signed body, no signature file, no new key, no log event, no memory, no link; the draft is unchanged). (2) A contract with no test_red_green criterion signs as today, with or without a base. (3) A remote caller (local:false) is unchanged: no git is run, no base is recorded, and verify stays BLOCKED until a local approval records one (SR-0.03.3 T1 requirement 6). (4) contractVerify is unchanged and keeps its BLOCKED for a missing base. (5) A spec with a test_red_green criterion names its base revision in its request, and its manifest row records it in base, as SR-0.03.3 does; the signer passes it with --base; docs/CONTRACTS.md says so. Boundaries: (a) no signed body, record or spec is touched, and the gate --report output does not change, because existing records are grandfathered; back-filling the base through superseding versions is a register follow-up, not part of this contract. (b) The scope criterion has the same BLOCKED without a base; this contract does not extend the refusal to it. (c) The red evidence of existing signed criteria that was really a load error, and the commands that cut their output with a tail, are register follow-ups owned by each spec's author. (d) A cut TAP header is the separate contract SR-W-03A. Base revision: ba24c82e16c91f5962f20d49b396d46054a505da, the memev main commit that merged pull request #358; it is the commit the red runs of this contract are judged at, and the signer drafts with --workdir at the checkout top level and --base this commit (criterion 12 pins it). No production caller beyond signing itself: contractSign is already called by the CLI and the MCP tool; no export is added. The tests reach the engine only through Vault.contractDraft and Vault.contractSign; if an export is added anyway, the test imports it with import() inside the test body, so a missing export fails on an assertion and not at load. Depends on contracts: SR-0.03.3 (signed). Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository; tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier. Nothing in this contract decides ADR 3, ADR 5, ADR 7 or SO-A-05.

tasks.title: Signing refuses a contract with a test_red_green criterion when no base revision can be recorded, and a spec names its base revision
requirements: for a local caller, after the base is resolved by the existing rule (the explicit base of the draft, else git rev-parse HEAD of the workdir when it is a git checkout), contractSign throws a ContractError with code no_base when the contract has a test_red_green criterion in any task and no base was found; the message says that a base is needed and how to give one (a base in the draft or --base <sha>, or a workdir that is a git checkout) (source: src/engine/contracts.mjs, contractSign; docs/CONTRACTS.md, Base revision)

the refusal is made before the DSSE signature, the key write, the signed-body and signature writes, the contract.signed event, the memory and the links: a refused sign writes nothing and leaves the draft as it was

a contract with no test_red_green criterion signs as today, with a base when one is found and without one otherwise; a contract with a test_red_green criterion signs and records base = { sha, recorded_at } when an explicit base or a git workdir gives one, as today

a remote caller (local:false) is unchanged: contractSign runs no git, records no base and does not refuse, and contractVerify returns BLOCKED with 'no base revision recorded' for its scope and red-green criteria until a local approval records one (source: SR-0.03.3 T1 requirement 6)

contractVerify is unchanged, including the BLOCKED detail 'no base revision recorded' for a body without a base; no signed body, red-team record or spec file changes, and the output of the gate --report does not change

docs/CONTRACTS.md, in the Base revision section, says that signing refuses a contract with a test_red_green criterion and no base, and that a spec with a test_red_green criterion names its base revision in its request and in the base field of its manifest row, and that the signer passes it with --base

the new test file reaches the engine only through Vault.contractDraft and Vault.contractSign, and each red-green criterion of this task runs only its own subtest, whose name starts with T1-cNN: (NN is the criterion's position in this task) (source: the convention of SR-0.03.3 T1 requirement 8)
tasks.description: Repo: memev. Depends on nothing that is not on main: SR-0.03.3 is signed and its base recording is in src/engine/contracts.mjs at the base. The refusal sits in contractSign, the one function every signing route calls (the CLI, and the MCP tool over a local token). The fixtures are the git repositories and the vault of test/helpers/contracts-base.mjs and test/helpers/tmp.mjs. A read-only run of the 91 tests of the twelve test files that sign a test_red_green criterion, with the refusal added, was green.

criteria.statement: A local contract with a test_red_green criterion and no base (a workdir that is not a git checkout, or no workdir, and no explicit base) is refused with code no_base and a message that names a base in the draft or --base and a git checkout. The test fails before the change (the contract signs) on an assertion, not on a load error, and passes after

A refused signing writes nothing: the listing of the vault's contracts folder is the same before and after, the draft is byte-identical, no signed body exists and the signature check of the id fails. The test fails before the change on an assertion and passes after

A contract with a test_red_green criterion signs and records its base when an explicit base or a git workdir gives one, and a contract with no test_red_green criterion signs without a base, with and without a git workdir. This holds before and after the change
A remote caller signs a contract with a test_red_green criterion as before: no base is recorded, and verify is BLOCKED until a local approval records one. This holds before and after the change
The base tests stay green: recording at signing, the legacy contract without a base (BLOCKED with 'no base revision recorded'), the format, the environment and the remote cases

verifier.cmd: node --test test/contracts-base.test.mjs test/contracts-base-legacy.test.mjs test/contracts-base-format.test.mjs test/contracts-base-env.test.mjs test/contracts-base-remote.test.mjs test/contracts-base-unknown.test.mjs

criteria.statement: The gate --report is byte-identical with and without the change: run on the same contracts tree, once with src, scripts and vendor as they are and once with them restored from the base, the two outputs do not differ

verifier.cmd: h=$(mktemp -d) && b=$(mktemp -d) && git worktree add -q --detach "$h" HEAD && git worktree add -q --detach "$b" HEAD && git -C "$b" checkout -q "$MEMEV_CONTRACT_BASE" -- src scripts vendor && (cd "$h" && node scripts/gate/redteam-gate.mjs --report > "$h.out" 2>&1); (cd "$b" && node scripts/gate/redteam-gate.mjs --report > "$b.out" 2>&1); diff "$h.out" "$b.out"; rc=$?; git worktree remove --force "$h"; git worktree remove --force "$b"; exit $rc

criteria.statement: No signed body, signature, red-team record or existing spec file differs from the base

verifier.cmd: git diff --exit-code "$MEMEV_CONTRACT_BASE" HEAD -- contracts/signed contracts/keys contracts/quality-loop contracts/scope-one contracts/seed-readiness

criteria.statement: One full run of test/contracts-sign-base.test.mjs passes every labelled subtest (T1-c01, T1-c02, T1-c03, T1-c04) with nothing skipped and nothing todo, and prints its whole output.

verifier.cmd: f=$(mktemp) && node --test --test-reporter=tap test/contracts-sign-base.test.mjs > "$f" 2>&1; rc=$?; cat "$f"; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && grep -Eq '^# skipped 0$' "$f" && grep -Eq '^# todo 0$' "$f" && grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*ok [0-9]+ - T1-c01:' "$f" && grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*ok [0-9]+ - T1-c02:' "$f" && grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*ok [0-9]+ - T1-c03:' "$f" && grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*ok [0-9]+ - T1-c04:' "$f"

criteria.statement: The change adds no export and touches no other file of src, scripts or vendor, and the test file has no static import of the engine

verifier.cmd: test -z "$(git diff "$MEMEV_CONTRACT_BASE" HEAD -- src/engine/contracts.mjs | grep -E '^\+export ')" && test -z "$(git diff --name-only "$MEMEV_CONTRACT_BASE" HEAD -- src scripts vendor | grep -vx src/engine/contracts.mjs)" && ! grep -Eq "^import .*src/engine" test/contracts-sign-base.test.mjs

criteria.statement: This contract is drafted with the memev checkout as its workdir and a pinned base. The workdir is the checkout top level (git rev-parse --show-toplevel equals the working directory). The base is ba24c82e16c91f5962f20d49b396d46054a505da, the memev main commit that merged pull request #358 (SO-F-03), the commit the red runs are judged at.
The leak scan passes on files
The leak scan passes on every commit message
Commits are authored by the repository owner's GitHub account with its noreply address, carry no AI markers, and add no em-dash

verifier.cmd: test -z "$(git log origin/main..HEAD --format=%ae | grep -v 'users.noreply.github.com$')" && test -z "$(git log origin/main..HEAD --format=%B | grep -iE 'co-authored-by|generated (with|by)')" && test -z "$(git diff origin/main...HEAD | grep -F "$(printf '\342\200\224')")"

criteria.statement: Committed and pushed on its own branch for review; nothing is pushed to main

stop_rules: No weakening of an existing test, no raised timeout, no skip, no widened scope; if blocked, report what blocks and continue with the next independent task.
A criterion that cannot be checked from this repository is reported as unchecked, never marked as passing.
Anything outside the requirements of this task is not built, not stubbed and not defaulted in code; if the work seems to need it, stop and report what it needs.
A test_red_green command of this contract prints its whole output: it is never piped through tail or head, and never captures its output without printing it.
